subject: Hosting-ready dining and hallway storage for Christmas
hook: We have guests coming for Christmas. Is it too late to start?
fb:
We are being asked this a lot at the moment, so here is a straight answer.

We have guests coming for Christmas. Is it too late to start?

We will not promise to have anything fitted by a particular date before we have seen your space and agreed a design. Every piece is made in our own workshop, and we would rather tell you honestly than rush it.

What you can do now: book a free consultation, agree the design and get your itemised quote, so it is planned and ready to schedule. And this Christmas will show you exactly where the storage pinch points are, which makes the design better.

Ask us anything or arrange a consultation here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=year-end-inspiration-and-trust&utm_content=day-112
gbp:
Is it too late to plan fitted furniture before Christmas?

It is never too late to start planning, but we will not promise a fitting date before we have seen your space and agreed a design. Every SUPERIO piece is designed with you, manufactured in our own Hanley workshop and installed by our own team, and we would rather be honest about timing than rush it.

What you can do now is book a free, no-obligation design consultation, settle the layout and finishes, and receive an itemised quote with transparent pricing. Your project is then planned and ready to schedule.

Hosting over the holidays is also the best research you can do: note where coats pile up, where dishes have nowhere to go and what you could not find. Bring those notes to your consultation.

We work with homes across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire.
